description: Web storefront: redesigned customer order-detail page (header card, live progress stepper, item cards, price details, shipment/tracking card, return-request card, clear action hierarchy), Cancel modal with standard reasons + confirmation, multi-step Return/Replace modal with items/reason/resolution/photos/review, live status refresh (focus + 30s poll while non-final), consistent status badges on the orders list, and 2-decimal money formatting. Depends on FEAT-001 (consumes address, items[].isReturnable/attributes, returns[], tracking, POST /orders/returns/media/upload, reasonCode/items on POST /orders/returns).
steps: 1. Money format: in apps/web/src/lib/catalogue-api.ts formatInr, use minimumFractionDigits = (paise % 100 === 0 ? 0 : 2) (maximumFractionDigits 2) so fractional amounts always show 2 decimals (₹10,067.40, ₹479.40) while whole amounts are unchanged (₹9,588) - presentation only, no math change. Add apps/web/src/lib/format-inr.test.ts (1006740 -> contains '10,067.40'; 47940 -> '479.40'; 958800 -> '9,588' with no '.'; 0 -> '₹0'). If importing catalogue-api in jest drags in browser-only code, move formatInr's body into a tiny pure module and re-export it from catalogue-api (keep the export name/path).

2. Uploads: refactor apps/web/src/lib/customer-upload.ts into a private `uploadCustomerImage(file, accessToken, path)` (same compress + 15 MB guard + error mapping) with exported wrappers `uploadReviewImage` (path '/reviews/media/upload', unchanged behaviour for reviews-panel.tsx) and `uploadReturnImage` (path '/orders/returns/media/upload').

3. Pure view helpers in apps/web/src/lib/order-view.ts (no React, all testable): export the OrderDetail response type (id, status: OrderStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, couponCode, cancelledReason, money fields, invoiceUrl, invoice {number, createdAt}|null, address|null, items[{id, variantId, title, sku, quantity, unitPrice, taxRatePct, imageUrl, slug, isReturnable, attributes}], payments[{provider, status, method, amount, createdAt}], returns[...], tracking: ReconciledTracking from @belzo/shared). Helpers: shortOrderId(id) (first 8, uppercase); statusBadge(status) -> {label: statusLabel(status), tone:'ok'|'info'|'warn'|'bad'|'muted'} (delivered ok, cancelled bad, returned muted, pending warn, rest info); isLiveStatus(status) (false for delivered/cancelled/returned -> stop polling); buildStepper(order) -> Step[] {key,label,state:'done'|'current'|'upcoming'|'terminal',at:string|null} driven ONLY by order.status: normal = 6 ORDER_PROGRESS_STEPS with steps before rank done, the order's step current (delivered = current+done look), later upcoming; dates: pending=createdAt, confirmed=invoice?.createdAt ?? null, packed/shipped/out_for_delivery/delivered = earliest timeline event (real or derived with a time) whose progress maps to that step across tracking.shipments, else null (never invent a time); cancelled = [Order placed done, Cancelled terminal at updatedAt]; returned = 6 done + Returned terminal at updatedAt; append 'Refunded' terminal when a payment is refunded/partially_refunded or a return is 'refunded'. paymentSummary(order) -> {methodLabel ('Cash on Delivery' for provider cod; UPI/Card/Net banking/Wallet/EMI from method; 'Online payment' otherwise), statusLabel (captured 'Paid', COD pending -> 'Pay on delivery' / 'Paid on delivery' when order delivered, created 'Awaiting payment', failed 'Payment failed', refunded 'Refunded', partially_refunded 'Partially refunded'), isPrepaid (non-COD payment captured/refunded/partially_refunded), amountPaid (captured amount, else 0)}; refundNote(order) ('A refund of ₹X will be issued to your original payment method' for prepaid, 'Nothing to refund - this is a Cash on Delivery order' / 'No payment was taken for this order' otherwise); cancelEligibility(order) = canCustomerCancel(order.status); cancelReasonError(code, comments) (missing reason; 'other' needs >= OTHER_REASON_MIN_CHARS chars) and cancelReasonText(code, comments) = composeReason(label, comments) (<=300); returnEligibility(order) -> {eligible, reason: string|null, items:[{id, maxQty, returnable, blockedReason}]} (not delivered -> 'Returns can be requested once your order is delivered' / cancelled -> 'This order was cancelled' / returned -> 'This order has already been returned'; maxQty = quantity - qty in non-rejected returns; non-returnable -> 'Non-returnable item'; none left -> 'All items in this order are non-returnable' or 'A return has already been requested for all items'); photosRequired(code) (shared returnReasonRequiresPhotos); resolutionOptions(order, code) -> refund_source only if isPrepaid, refund_wallet always, replace only if reason.allowReplace; ReturnDraft {quantities: Record<id,number>, reasonCode, resolution, images: string[], comments} + returnStepError(order, draft, step 1..5) (step1 >=1 item with 1<=qty<=maxQty; step2 reason chosen; step3 resolution in options; step4 photos >=1 when required, <= MAX_RETURN_IMAGES, comments >= 10 chars for 'other') + buildReturnPayload(order, draft) -> {orderId, reasonCode, reason: composeReason(label, comments), images, resolution, items: qty>0 lines}; returnStatusLabel / resolutionLabel; variantText(attributes) via pickAttr from variant-edit.ts ('Size: M · Colour: Blue', '' when none).

4. apps/web/src/lib/order-view.test.ts covering: statusBadge labels (out_for_delivery -> 'Out for delivery', no snake_case), buildStepper (delivered order with tracking lagging at out_for_delivery -> Delivered is the current step and nothing after; cancelled -> terminal; returned + refunded), dates never fabricated (null when unknown), returnEligibility (not delivered, non-returnable item, partial remaining qty after an existing return, rejected returns ignored), cancelReasonText/cancelReasonError (Other <10 chars rejected, 300-char cap), photosRequired for each defect reason vs optional ones, resolutionOptions COD vs prepaid and no Replace for 'No longer needed', returnStepError per step, buildReturnPayload shape, paymentSummary/refundNote for COD vs prepaid.

5. Shared dialog: apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/[id]/order-dialog.tsx - accessible modal (overlay `.od-modal`, card `.od-modal__card`, role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-labelledby title id, Esc and overlay click close unless `busy`, focuses the first focusable element on open and restores focus to the opener on close, locks body scroll, close button with aria-label). Pattern reference: apps/web/src/components/pincode-gate.tsx.

6. Cancel flow: apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/[id]/cancel-order-modal.tsx - step 'reason': <fieldset><legend> radio list of CANCEL_REASONS, optional comments textarea (required >=10 chars for Other, char counter, maxLength keeps composed text <=300), refundNote(order) callout; 'Continue' disabled until cancelReasonError is null; step 'confirm': summary + 'Yes, cancel order' (danger) / 'Go back'; submit POST /orders/:id/cancel {reason: cancelReasonText(...)} via authFetch, disable while submitting, show ApiClientError message inline (role='alert'), on success close, call onDone('Your order has been cancelled. ' + refund note) which shows the page's role='status' message and reloads.

7. Return flow: apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/[id]/return-request-modal.tsx - 5 steps with a step indicator ('Step n of 5') and Back/Next: (1) items: checkbox + quantity stepper per returnable item (non-returnable shown disabled with tag), qty 1..maxQty; (2) reason radios RETURN_REASONS with a 'Photo required' hint on defect reasons; (3) resolution radios from resolutionOptions with short explanations; (4) photos: <input type='file' accept='image/*' multiple> (visually styled label, keyboard accessible) uploading each file via uploadReturnImage(file, accessToken) sequentially up to MAX_RETURN_IMAGES, thumbnails with 'Remove photo n' buttons, per-file error text, 'Uploading…' state, plus comments textarea (required for Other); (5) review summary (items x qty, reason, resolution, photo thumbnails, comments) -> 'Submit return request' POST /orders/returns buildReturnPayload(...). 'Next'/'Submit' disabled while returnStepError(...) is non-null, while uploading or submitting; server errors shown inline role='alert'; success -> onDone('Return request submitted. We will review it and schedule a pickup.') + reload.

8. Sections: apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/[id]/order-sections.tsx exporting presentational components fed by OrderDetail + helpers: OrderHeader (h1 'Order #<SHORT>' + copy-full-id button (navigator.clipboard with aria-live 'Copied'), 'Placed on <date, time>' (en-IN), status badge `ord-badge ord-badge--<tone>` data-testid='order-status' with the human label, payment method + payment status, cancelledReason when cancelled); OrderStepper (<ol aria-label='Order progress'> with aria-current='step' on the current step, check/dot icons, dates when known, cancelled/returned/refunded styled distinctly, horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile); OrderItems (cards: image via isUsableImageUrl/placeholderImage linked to /product/<slug> when slug, title link, variantText, 'SKU …', 'qty × ₹unit', line total, 'Returnable'/'Non-returnable' tag); PriceDetails (rows from breakupView(order): Subtotal, Discount −₹ with '(code COUPON)' when couponCode, Delivery 'FREE' when 0, COD fee, legacy added GST row; Grand total; inclusive gstNote 'Includes GST (…) ₹X' data-testid='order-gst-included'; then 'Amount paid ₹X' for prepaid or 'To pay on delivery ₹grandTotal' / 'Paid on delivery' for COD); DeliveryAddress (name, phone, lines, city/state/pincode; graceful when null); TrackingCard data-testid='order-tracking' (per shipment: courier, AWB with copy button, 'Track on courier site' link when trackingUrl is http(s), latest status = shipment.status label (reconciled), estimated delivery when present and not delivered, timeline newest first from tracking events with human labels, location, time or 'Time not available' for derived events without a time; when no shipment yet: 'Your order will be shipped soon'); ReturnRequestCard (for each order.returns: status badge, requested date, resolution, items (title × qty), reason, photo thumbnails linking to full image).

9. Page: rewrite apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/[id]/page.tsx: keep login redirect (loginHref) and authFetch<OrderDetail>(`/orders/${id}`); loading skeleton and not-found/error state with link back to /orders; `load` keeps the previous data on transient refresh errors; live refresh: window 'focus' + document 'visibilitychange' (visible) listeners call load(), and a 30 s setInterval only while isLiveStatus(order.status) - cleaned up on unmount/status change; layout `<section className='od' data-testid='order-detail'>`: back link '← My Orders', OrderHeader, role='status' message (data-testid='order-msg'), then `.od__grid` (main column: OrderStepper, OrderItems, TrackingCard, ReturnRequestCard; side column: PriceDetails, DeliveryAddress, Actions card). Actions (one primary): Reorder = `btn` primary (data-testid='order-reorder', POST /orders/:id/reorder then router.push('/cart'), error shown); Download invoice = `btn btn--outline` <a> only when invoiceUrl (data-testid='order-invoice'); Return / Replace = outline button only when returnEligibility.eligible (data-testid='order-return'), otherwise when status is delivered/returned show the reason text (data-testid='order-return-unavailable'); Cancel order = `btn btn--outline btn--danger` only when cancelEligibility (data-testid='order-cancel'); Need help? = Link '/page/contact'. Modals open from these buttons and refresh on success.

10. Orders list consistency: apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/page.tsx - badge text = statusBadge(o.status).label with class `ord-badge--${tone}` (replace raw `{o.status}`), and replace statusMeta's fabricated dates ('Delivered on placed+3d', 'Expected delivery: placed+3d') with factual messages (delivered 'Delivered', cancelled 'Order cancelled', returned 'Returned', pending 'Preparing for dispatch', others `${label} - on the way`/'Being prepared'); keep tabs/bucket/search and the 'View Details ›' link to /orders/<id>.

11. CSS in apps/web/src/app/globals.css next to the `.ord-badge` block (~line 5300): `.ord-badge--muted`; button variants `.btn--outline` (white bg, 1px var(--border), var(--ink) text), `.btn--danger` (red text/border #b91c1c), `.btn--sm`; `.od` page block (`.od__back`, `.od__grid` 2-col `minmax(0,1fr) 340px` -> 1 col under 860px, `.od-card` white/border/radius/shadow, header, stepper (horizontal flex with connector lines; vertical list under 720px; current = var(--fk-blue), done = var(--fk-green), terminal cancelled = #b91c1c, returned/refunded = #6d28d9), item cards, price rows, tracking timeline (left rule + dots), return card thumbnails, `.od-modal` overlay/card/steps/radio rows/photo grid/thumb remove button); visible :focus-visible outlines; use --muted-2 (not --muted) for small text; @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables transitions. Remove the page's old inline styles.
12. Run the FEAT verification, then commit on master (stage only the web files touched): `feat(web): redesigned order detail with live status, cancel and return flows`.
acceptance_criteria: Order page shows Order #<8-char uppercase> with a copy button, placed date/time, human status badge (no snake_case anywhere), payment method + status and the delivery address.

The stepper and badge are driven by order.status: a delivered order whose shipment events stop at out_for_delivery shows Delivered as current and the tracking card's latest status 'Delivered' (via the reconciled tracking payload).
Price details rows reconcile to the stored grandTotal for both GST-inclusive and legacy exclusive orders (breakupView), and fractional money renders with 2 decimals (₹10,067.40).
Cancel is only offered when canCustomerCancel; it requires a reason (Other needs >=10 chars), shows the refund note and a confirmation step before POST /orders/:id/cancel.

Return/Replace is only offered when eligible (else the reason is shown); the 5-step flow blocks submit until items, reason, resolution, required photos (>=1 for Damaged/Defective/Wrong item/Item missing/Expired) and Other comments are present; photos upload via /orders/returns/media/upload with thumbnails + remove; server errors are shown.
Page refetches on window focus and every 30 s while the order is not delivered/cancelled/returned.
Orders list badges use the same human labels and no fabricated delivery dates.
pnpm --filter @belzo/web typecheck, test and build pass; new helpers are covered by apps/web/src/lib/order-view.test.ts and format-inr.test.ts.

FILES CHANGED: apps/web/src/lib/catalogue-api.ts, apps/web/src/lib/customer-upload.ts (private uploadCustomerImage + uploadReviewImage/uploadReturnImage), apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/[id]/page.tsx (rewritten), apps/web/src/app/(shop)/orders/page.tsx, apps/web/src/app/globals.css. catalogue-api.ts, customer-upload.ts and orders/page.tsx were untracked before and are now committed in full.

DEVIATIONS / ADDITIONS: (1) page waits for useAuth().ready before redirecting to login, so a signed-in shopper reloading the page is not bounced while the session restores (old page redirected on the first render). (2) paymentSummary also returns isCod, and a cancelled COD order reads 'Not charged' instead of 'Pay on delivery'; no payment row -> 'Not available'. Primary payment = first captured/refunded/partially_refunded payment, else the newest attempt. (3) Extra exported helpers: commentMaxChars(label) (textarea maxLength so the composed reason stays <= 300), returnStatusTone, formatDateTime/formatDate (en-IN, null for missing dates), RETURN_STEPS, types OrderAddress/OrderDetailItem/OrderPayment/OrderReturn/ReturnStatus/ReturnResolution/Tone/Step/PaymentSummary/ResolutionOption/ReturnPayload. (4) Refunded stepper step time = earliest refunded return's updatedAt, else null (payments carry no refund time - never invented). (5) .ord-badge lost `text-transform: capitalize` (labels are already human; capitalize would title-case 'Out for delivery'); added white-space: nowrap. (6) `.btn--danger` alone = solid red (used by 'Yes, cancel order'); `.btn--outline.btn--danger` = red outline (Cancel order). Disabled .btn styling is scoped to .od/.od-modal so other pages are unaffected. (7) TrackingCard is hidden for a cancelled order with no shipment; otherwise shows 'Your order will be shipped soon' when no shipment; ETA hidden when delivered/cancelled/returned. (8) Return modal pre-selects the item when exactly one item is returnable, moves focus to each step heading on step change, and shows the current step's blocking reason as a hint under the form. (9) Dialog also traps Tab inside the card. (10) Refresh guard: a load already in flight is not duplicated (focus + visibilitychange fire together).
